purpose: Compact coordination index, not a replacement for evidence or a claim of whole-product acceptance.
rules: Implementation, validation and deployment are separate facts.
Evidence applies only to recorded source/environment/state; changed source requires affected checks.
Failed fidelity gates hold release even when unit tests pass.
Update a row on meaningful state change; agents hand off only changed facts, blockers and evidence paths.
Keep private captures and original assets outside public Git.
Acceptance never propagates across RTM/OSR releases or Plus/Desktop Update configurations.
Each accepted variant must retain explicit state/environment conditions and evidence.
A prepared reference is not a passed feature test; missing media/reference stays explicit.
Source fingerprints cover listed files only; they do not certify the whole build or transfer old evidence to changed code.
Applications use measured component/binary identities; an OS release label alone must not invent Notepad/WordPad menu or feature changes.

notes: IE browser installation is not equivalent to IE4 Desktop Update.
Plus95 components are independent of shell generation.
Active Desktop and folder Web View are independent settings requiring Desktop Update when enabled.
Profiles describe requested/reference configurations, not a claim that every combination is historically installed or tested.
Ledger logic tracks evidence; it does not change runtime feature flags.
A Plus pack label does not prove each optional component was installed; component inventory can remain unknown.
Retail+SP1 and OEM OSR1 are tracked separately even though the displayed A label can overlap.

variant_statuses.not_tested: No qualifying evidence for this exact profile; no inheritance from another release.
variant_statuses.partial_evidence: Only the explicitly listed behavior/control states have evidence.
variant_statuses.accepted: Named criteria and exact conditions satisfied; never inferred from another profile.
